name: vite-plugin-lit-css-example
description: A walk through the CSS features of @oddsquad/vite-plugin-lit, one card per delivery shape: UnoCSS utilities as one shared adopted sheet, design tokens, a linked stylesheet, inlined CSS and a css literal run through Lightning CSS.
